What we do

Everything under
one roof.

One team from first sketch to final handover —
no subcontracting, no hand-offs.

Interior Design

Concept, space planning, materials and FF&E — interiors composed around the people who use them.

Fit-Out

Full contracting and execution — partitions, MEP, joinery and finishes by our own workforce.

Design + Build

One contract, one line of responsibility — the people who draw it are the people who build it.

Villa Renovation

Total interior renovation, extensions and upgrades for residential properties across the UAE.

Landscape & Pools

Outdoor rooms, hardscape, planting and pool works — the interior extended outside.

Project Management

Programme, procurement and site supervision — time, cost and craft under one accountable team.

The studio

Space is never
just space.

OPRELL Interiors & Fit-Out is a Dubai design and build practice delivering interior fit-out, villa renovation and landscape works across the UAE.

Everything is executed in-house — our own masons, carpenters, painters, electricians and supervisors. From first sketch to handover: one team, one line of responsibility.
